title.zh: 伊朗飛彈第一次瞄準的是美軍艦本身：CENTCOM『一換三』摧毀三艘伊朗油輪的同一天，俄軍無人機打進基輔SBU總部瞄準代理局長辦公室——川普特使隔天才踏進Kyiv；五角大廈同時私下告訴承包商，Anthropic的『供應鏈風險』標籤根本沒撤
title.en: Iran's Missiles Aim at a US Warship for the First Time — the Same Day CENTCOM Answers by Destroying Three Iranian Tankers, a Russian Drone Hits SBU Headquarters in Kyiv Aimed at the Acting Chief's Office, One Day Before Trump's Envoys Land in the Capital; Meanwhile the Pentagon Quietly Tells Contractors Anthropic's 'Supply Chain Risk' Label Never Actually Came Off

focus.zh: 本期焦點：9/5，IRGC首次不再攻擊商船，改朝美國海軍一艘航艦與一艘飛彈驅逐艦發射彈道飛彈(均遭規避、無人受傷)；CENTCOM同日以摧毀三艘伊朗政府油輪反制(M/T Downy、Stark 1永久失能，M/T Kylo徹底摧毀)，司令Adm. Brad Cooper公開喊出『2換3』的懲罰比例——9/4報告記錄的『至少壓制伊朗一個月』評估，只撐了4天。同一天(9/4)，俄軍渦輪噴射無人機直擊基輔SBU總部大樓，Zelensky稱瞄準的正是代理局長Poklad辦公室，這是戰爭4年半來SBU總部首次挨炸，恰好發生在美方特使Witkoff與Kushner啟程赴Moscow與Kyiv的前一天。兩人9/5與Putin密談5小時未談出領土共識，Putin下令基輔停戰3天配合兩人9/6轉往Kyiv與Zelensky會面，Zelensky同步宣布對等暫停空襲。科技治理端：一名五角大廈資深官員9/3向媒體證實，儘管加州聯邦法院8/27已判Anthropic『供應鏈風險』標籤違憲，該標籤本身『依然有效』——9/2報告當時的警告『這只是程序性勝訴，行政部門仍可換一條法律路徑』，4天內即被證實。資安端：CISA 9/2把LiteLLM(開源AI閘道器)未授權RCE攻擊鏈的最後一塊拼圖與其MCP端點另一漏洞一併列入KEV，資安研究人員指出，利用這條攻擊鏈的操作者之一正是本站8/28報告記錄過、入侵ATF查案伺服器的Qilin勒索軟體集團。台灣方面，KMT與TPP兩黨團9/4聯合表態，要求行政院與總統賴清德必須先公告施行在野版無人機條例，立法院才會討論9/3提出的NT$6,076億追加預算案(含此前遭否決的NT$1,457億國防經費)。
focus.en: This cycle's focus: on 9/5 the IRGC, for the first time, stopped attacking commercial ships and fired ballistic missiles at a US Navy carrier and a guided-missile destroyer instead (both evaded, no casualties); CENTCOM answered the same day by destroying three Iranian government tankers (M/T Downy and Stark 1 permanently disabled, M/T Kylo completely destroyed), with commander Adm. Brad Cooper publicly declaring a '2-for-3' punitive ratio — the 'at least a month' suppression estimate our 9/4 report logged lasted just four days. The same day (9/4), a Russian turbojet drone struck SBU headquarters in Kyiv, which Zelensky said was aimed directly at acting chief Poklad's office — the first time SBU HQ has been hit in four and a half years of war, landing one day before US envoys Witkoff and Kushner set off for Moscow and Kyiv. The two spent five hours with Putin on 9/5 without reaching territorial compromise; Putin ordered a three-day pause on Kyiv timed to their 9/6 trip to meet Zelensky, who announced a reciprocal pause on Ukrainian airstrikes. On AI governance: a senior Pentagon official confirmed to media on 9/3 that, despite the California federal court's 8/27 ruling that Anthropic's 'supply chain risk' label was unconstitutional, the label itself 'remains in effect' — confirming within four days the warning in our 9/2 report that the court win was only procedural and the administration could simply switch legal tracks. On cyber: CISA on 9/2 added the missing piece of LiteLLM's (an open-source AI gateway) unauthenticated RCE chain, plus a separate flaw in its MCP endpoint, to its KEV catalog; researchers linked one of the operators exploiting this chain to Qilin, the same ransomware crew our 8/28 report documented breaching an ATF investigation-records server. In Taiwan, the KMT and TPP caucuses jointly demanded on 9/4 that the Executive Yuan and President Lai first promulgate the opposition's own drone act before the legislature will even discuss the 9/3 NT$607.6 billion supplementary budget (which includes the previously rejected NT$145.7 billion in defense spending).

title.zh: CISA把LiteLLM未授權RCE攻擊鏈的最後一塊拼圖正式列入KEV：入侵ATF的同一個Qilin勒索集團，正在把AI閘道器本身當成新入口
title.en: CISA Adds the Missing Piece of LiteLLM's Unauthenticated RCE Chain to Its KEV Catalog — the Same Qilin Ransomware Crew That Breached ATF Is Now Treating the AI Gateway Itself as the Front Door

summary.zh: CISA於9/2把七項在野利用的漏洞列入KEV(已知遭利用漏洞)目錄，其中三項直接命中AI代理人基礎設施本身。第一組是LiteLLM——一套開源、被大量企業用來統一路由各家LLM API呼叫的『AI閘道器』：資安業者Horizon3.ai今年6月已示範，LiteLLM本身的CVE-2026-42271可以串接其依賴的ASGI框架Starlette裡一個主機標頭驗證繞過漏洞CVE-2026-48710，串起後形成一條完全不需登入、不需API金鑰、CVSS達10.0滿分的未驗證遠端程式碼執行路徑；CISA這次正式把CVE-2026-48710(串接用的後半段)與LiteLLM另一個獨立漏洞CVE-2026-59822(其MCP〔Model Context Protocol，AI代理人與外部工具溝通的標準協定〕Streamable HTTP端點的驗證缺陷，讓攻擊者能用任意Bearer token偽造已驗證的MCP連線)一併收錄，代表這整條攻擊鏈與其MCP旁支目前都在被積極利用。研究人員指出，利用這條LiteLLM攻擊鏈的其中一批操作者，與本站8/28報告記錄過、入侵ATF查案伺服器的Qilin勒索軟體集團有關聯。同一批七項漏洞中，另有工作流程自動化工具Kestra的OS指令注入漏洞(CVE-2026-49869)被用於建立反向殼層並部署加密貨幣挖礦程式，以及SonicWall SMA1000防火牆一組CVSS 10.0的未驗證SSRF漏洞(可串接成RCE)。
summary.en: On 9/2 CISA added seven actively exploited vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, three of which hit AI-agent infrastructure directly. The first is LiteLLM — an open-source 'AI gateway' widely deployed by enterprises to route API calls across different LLM providers: security firm Horizon3.ai demonstrated in June that LiteLLM's own CVE-2026-42271 could be chained with CVE-2026-48710, a host-header validation bypass in Starlette, the ASGI framework LiteLLM depends on, producing a fully unauthenticated remote-code-execution path — no login, no API key, CVSS 10.0. CISA's latest addition formally lists CVE-2026-48710 (the half of the chain that completes it) alongside a separate LiteLLM flaw, CVE-2026-59822, an authentication defect in its Model Context Protocol (MCP — the standard protocol AI agents use to talk to external tools) Streamable HTTP endpoint that lets an attacker forge an authenticated MCP session using an arbitrary Bearer token — meaning both the main chain and its MCP-adjacent flaw are now confirmed under active exploitation. Researchers have linked some of the operators exploiting this LiteLLM chain to Qilin, the same ransomware crew this outlet's 8/28 report documented breaching an ATF investigation-records server. The same batch of seven also includes an OS command-injection flaw in the workflow-automation tool Kestra (CVE-2026-49869), used to open reverse shells and deploy cryptominers, and an unauthenticated, CVSS-10.0 SSRF flaw in SonicWall's SMA1000 firewall, chainable into RCE.

implication.zh: 這給你一個具體、可驗證的資料點，證明本站8/17週報『供應層即歸因層』與monthly報告『把對外部LLM/代理人服務的呼叫紀錄當成一級遙測』這兩個判斷正在同時成立：Qilin不是只挑一種目標型態——它8月鎖定的是聯邦執法機關的獨立伺服器，現在鎖定的是企業內部用來串接AI模型的閘道器本身，代表這個集團的目標選擇邏輯是『找到值錢的存取權』而非『鎖定特定產業』，任何持有LiteLLM或類似AI閘道器的組織都該假設自己在其潛在目標名單上。更值得注意的是MCP端點那個獨立漏洞：它讓攻擊者偽造一個『已驗證』的AI代理人工具呼叫連線，這意味着未來的入侵鑑識不能只看『這支API金鑰是誰的』，還要看『這個MCP session的建立時間與行為模式是否與正常代理人流量一致』——這正是provenance graph需要新增的一類邊。實務上，任何在生產環境跑LiteLLM或類似AI閘道器的組織，如果還沒把Starlette版本與LiteLLM版本分開盤點(很多團隊只檢查前者)，現在就該假設自己暴露在這條CVSS 10.0的鏈上。
implication.en: This gives you a concrete, checkable data point confirming that two judgments already on record — our 8/17 weekly's 'the supply layer is the new attribution layer' and the monthly report's recommendation to treat call records to external LLM/agent services as first-class telemetry — are both holding at once. Qilin isn't fixed on one target type: in August it hit a standalone federal law-enforcement server, and now it's hitting the AI gateway enterprises use internally to route model calls — meaning the group's targeting logic is 'wherever access is valuable,' not any one sector, so any organization running LiteLLM or a comparable AI gateway should assume it's on the group's potential target list. The MCP-endpoint flaw is worth flagging on its own: it lets an attacker forge what looks like an already-authenticated AI-agent tool-call session, which means future incident forensics can't stop at 'whose API key was this' — it has to ask whether an MCP session's creation time and behavior pattern match normal agent traffic. That's a new class of edge your provenance graph needs. Practically: any organization running LiteLLM or a similar AI gateway in production, if it hasn't separately inventoried its Starlette version alongside its LiteLLM version (most teams check only the latter), should assume it sits on this CVSS-10.0 chain right now.

counterpoint.zh: 把Qilin與這條LiteLLM攻擊鏈綁在一起的證據，目前仍是資安業者的漏洞利用鏈分析與威脅歸因，而非CISA或司法部的正式起訴文件——CISA的KEV收錄只證實『這個漏洞正被利用』，並未官方認定利用者身分；且CVE-2026-42271本身早在6月就已列入KEV並被公開示警數月，這次新增的CVE-2026-48710與MCP漏洞代表的是攻擊鏈『後半段』與『旁支』被正式確認，而非全新的攻擊行為首次出現，實際利用時間可能比CISA收錄日期更早。
counterpoint.en: The link between Qilin and this LiteLLM chain currently rests on security-vendor exploit-chain analysis and threat attribution, not a formal CISA or DOJ attribution document — KEV listing only confirms 'this flaw is being exploited,' not who is doing it officially. Also, CVE-2026-42271 itself was already added to KEV back in June and publicly warned about for months; what's new this cycle is CISA formally confirming the chain's back half (CVE-2026-48710) and its MCP-adjacent flaw, not a brand-new attack technique appearing for the first time — actual exploitation may well predate CISA's listing date.

items.source: CISA / Horizon3.ai（漏洞鏈驗證）／資安研究人員對Qilin的歸因，經 The Hacker News 轉述

title.zh: 伊朗飛彈第一次瞄準的是美軍艦，不是商船：IRGC彈道飛彈射向航艦與飛彈驅逐艦，CENTCOM『一換三』摧毀三艘伊朗油輪——9/4報告『至少壓制一個月』的評估，4天就破功
title.en: Iran's Missiles Target US Warships for the First Time, Not Commercial Ships: IRGC Fires Ballistic Missiles at a US Carrier and a Destroyer, CENTCOM Answers by Disabling or Destroying Three Iranian Tankers — the 9/4 Report's 'At Least a Month' Suppression Estimate Lasted Four Days

summary.zh: 9/5，伊朗革命衛隊(IRGC)向美國海軍一艘航空母艦與一艘飛彈驅逐艦發射多枚彈道飛彈，兩艦均成功規避、無人員傷亡——這是本輪衝突以來，伊朗首次直接以彈道飛彈瞄準美軍艦艇本身，而非此前針對商船或Jordan境內基地的騷擾式攻擊。CENTCOM同日宣布反制：美軍摧毀三艘伊朗政府原油輪，其中M/T Downy(Kharg Island外海)與M/T Stark 1(Jask附近)遭永久性癱瘓、M/T Kylo(於Oman灣，當時未載貨)遭徹底摧毀。CENTCOM司令Adm. Brad Cooper公開宣示比例原則：『若你們朝我們兩艘船開火，我們就摧毀你們三艘』——這把9/4報告記錄的『油輪換油輪』1:1報復原則，實際執行成2:3的懲罰性比例，且觸發點從『伊朗騷擾商船』直接升級為『伊朗攻擊美軍艦』。9/4當週Brent原油已因這一系列衝突站上每桶96美元、單週漲幅近9%，為7月中以來最強單週表現，兩週後即為9/15-16 FOMC會議。
summary.en: On 9/5 the IRGC fired multiple ballistic missiles at a US Navy aircraft carrier and a guided-missile destroyer; both evaded successfully, with no US casualties — the first time this round of the conflict has seen Iran aim ballistic missiles directly at US warships themselves, rather than the harassment-style attacks on commercial tankers or the Jordan base seen previously. CENTCOM announced its response the same day: US forces struck three Iranian government crude carriers — M/T Downy (off Kharg Island) and M/T Stark 1 (near Jask) were permanently disabled, and M/T Kylo (unladen, in the Gulf of Oman) was completely destroyed. CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper stated the ratio publicly: 'If you shoot at two of our ships, we will impose an even higher economic cost — taking out three of yours.' That turns the 1:1 'tanker for tanker' retaliation principle documented in our 9/4 report into an actual 2:3 punitive ratio, while shifting the trigger from Iran harassing commercial shipping to Iran directly attacking US warships. Brent crude, already climbing on this conflict, traded near $96/barrel the week of 9/4, up nearly 9% for the week — its strongest weekly performance since mid-July — two weeks before the 9/15-16 FOMC meeting.

implication.zh: 這條線索直接推翻了9/4報告記錄的美方評估：官員當時預期9/1那輪打擊能『讓伊朗威脅能力至少降低一個月』，而IRGC只花了4天，就把攻擊對象從騷擾商船升級到直接朝美軍航艦與驅逐艦開火——這不是『同一種騷擾又發生一次』，是攻擊對象等級的躍升，代表『至少一個月』這個時間窗口的評估基礎(伊朗需要時間重整部署佈雷或飛彈能力)本身就有問題，值得你重新檢視任何援引『美方官員評估』作為時間窗口依據的判斷，因為這是本站近期第二次記錄同一機構的評估被現實迅速打臉(第一次是8/28『水雷已清空』兩天後即被拆穿)。CENTCOM把報復比例從1:1講成2:3，且公開講明比例本身，這代表美方正在把『不對稱懲罰』當成公開的嚇阻語言使用——這對你追蹤能源與航運風險的意義是，接下來的觀察指標不該是『雙方是否還在打』，而是這個公開比例是否隨每一輪衝突繼續放大(3換4、4換5)，因為比例本身放大的速度，比任何單一衝突事件更能預示這條升級階梯還有多少空間。
implication.en: This directly falsifies the US assessment logged in our 9/4 report: officials expected the 9/1 strikes to suppress Iran's threat capability for 'at least a month,' and it took the IRGC just four days to escalate the target class itself — from harassing commercial shipping to firing directly at a US carrier and destroyer. That's not the same harassment recurring; it's an escalation in what gets targeted, which means the reasoning behind the 'at least a month' window (that Iran would need time to rebuild mining or missile capability) was flawed on its own terms. This is the second time in recent cycles this outlet has documented the same institution's estimate getting falsified fast by events — the first was the 'mines cleared' claim on 8/28 that was undercut within two days. CENTCOM stating its retaliation ratio publicly as 2:3 (rather than a flat 1:1) signals Washington is now using asymmetric punishment itself as a declared deterrent language — for anyone tracking energy and shipping risk, the indicator to watch going forward isn't whether the two sides keep fighting, it's whether this published ratio keeps widening with each round (3-for-4, 4-for-5): the rate at which the ratio itself grows tells you more about how much room is left on this escalation ladder than any single strike does.

counterpoint.zh: 兩艦『規避』飛彈的具體方式(攔截、電子反制、或單純航向偏離)目前尚未公開細節，若這批飛彈本身精準度存疑、甚至並非真正瞄準艦艇本身而是示警性質，則『直接瞄準美艦』的定性可能被誇大；此外，CENTCOM『一換三』的公開喊話也可能是設計給國內與盟邦看的嚇阻姿態，而非嚴格對應的軍事比例，未來是否真的每次都以2:3或更高比例反制，仍待更多輪次驗證。
counterpoint.en: The specific means by which both ships 'evaded' the missiles — interception, electronic countermeasures, or simply a course change — have not been publicly detailed; if the missiles' accuracy is in question, or if they were intended as a warning shot rather than a genuine attempt to hit the vessels, the framing of 'targeting US warships directly' could be overstated. CENTCOM's public '2-for-3' framing may also be a deterrence posture aimed at domestic and allied audiences rather than a strictly proportional military doctrine; whether the US actually answers every future incident at a 2:3 ratio or higher still needs more rounds to confirm.

items.source: CENTCOM / CNN / Bloomberg / Stars and Stripes

title.zh: 川普特使Witkoff與Kushner本屆任內首度踏進Moscow與Kyiv：與Putin密談5小時未談出領土共識，Putin下令基輔停戰3天，Zelensky同步喊出對等回應
title.en: Witkoff and Kushner Make Their First-Ever Trip Into Moscow and Kyiv This Term: Five Hours With Putin Yield No Territorial Compromise, Putin Orders a Three-Day Pause on Kyiv, Zelensky Answers in Kind

summary.zh: 美國總統特使Steve Witkoff與川普女婿Jared Kushner9/5抵達Moscow，與Putin展開長達5小時的會談——這是兩人自本屆政府上任以來首度踏上俄羅斯與烏克蘭領土，此前的穿梭外交均在第三地或以視訊進行。據Putin外交顧問Yuri Ushakov會後說法，雙方就領土議題交換意見但『尚未找到妥協方案』，俄方收到美方帶來的四份文件(其中一份含27項條款)，內容細節未公開；外部報導指出方案疑似涉及Kherson與Zaporizhzhia前線凍結、以及烏克蘭自Donetsk境內仍由己方控制的部分區域撤軍，但這些條款尚未獲美、俄、烏三方任何一方正式證實。會後Putin下令自9/5午夜起，一連3天暫停對Kyiv的攻擊，以配合Witkoff與Kushner兩人9/6轉往Kyiv與Zelensky會談的行程；Zelensky則公開表示烏方也將同步暫停對俄空襲作為對等回應，並形容自己已準備好進行『實質對話』。這是美國自本屆政府上任以來，首次由總統特使層級官員親自進入Kyiv與Zelensky當面談判。
summary.en: US presidential envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner (Trump's son-in-law) arrived in Moscow on 9/5 for a five-hour meeting with Putin — the first time either has set foot in Russia or Ukraine this term; prior shuttle diplomacy had all taken place elsewhere or by video call. Per Putin aide Yuri Ushakov's readout, the two sides exchanged views on territory but 'have not yet found a compromise'; Russia received four documents from the US side, including one with 27 points, whose contents have not been disclosed. Outside reporting suggests the proposal may involve freezing front lines in Kherson and Zaporizhzhia and a Ukrainian withdrawal from parts of Donetsk still under Kyiv's control, but none of the three parties has formally confirmed those terms. Following the meeting, Putin ordered a three-day pause on strikes against Kyiv starting at midnight on 9/5, timed to Witkoff and Kushner's planned 9/6 trip to Kyiv to meet Zelensky. Zelensky said Ukraine would pause its own airstrikes on Russia in kind, and that he was ready for a 'substantive conversation.' This marks the first time an envoy at the presidential-envoy level has entered Kyiv in person to negotiate with Zelensky since this US administration took office.

implication.zh: 對你判斷這場戰爭的政治可持續性，這是近幾個月最具體的一次程序性升級：從視訊與第三地會談，變成特使親自踏進Moscow與Kyiv兩地，這個形式本身的變化，比任何一份未公開的條款內容更能說明華府現在願意投入的政治資本規模。但『5小時談不出領土共識』與『Putin用停戰3天配合行程』要分開記帳——後者是戰術性的姿態管理(讓特使在烏克蘭首都訪問期間看起來安全、可控)，不代表俄方在談判實質內容上讓步；你在跟決策者對話時，該用的具體指標是這3天停戰期滿後，Kyiv是否恢復遭到攻擊——如果停戰期滿當天Kyiv隨即恢復被炸，代表這3天只是一次性的公關安排，而非任何實質降溫的開始。同時值得注意的是，這場會談發生在SBU總部才被擊中的陰影下(見本期另一條)，代表Zelensky是在國內安全機構同時承壓的狀態下進入這輪談判，這會影響他在領土議題上能夠對內部政治力量交代的讓步空間。
implication.en: For judging this war's political sustainability, this is the most concrete procedural escalation in months: moving from video calls and third-country venues to envoys physically entering Moscow and Kyiv is, on its own, a bigger signal of how much political capital Washington is now willing to commit than any undisclosed clause. But keep two things on separate ledgers: '5 hours produced no territorial compromise' and 'Putin timed a 3-day pause to the visit' — the latter is tactical stagecraft, making the envoys' visit to the Ukrainian capital look safe and controlled, not evidence of a substantive Russian concession. The concrete indicator for conversations with policymakers is whether Kyiv resumes taking strikes the moment this three-day window lapses — if it does, the pause was a one-off PR arrangement, not the start of any real de-escalation. Also worth noting: this meeting is happening in the shadow of the SBU headquarters strike covered elsewhere in this brief, meaning Zelensky enters this round of talks with his own security apparatus under domestic pressure at the same time — which will shape how much room he actually has to make territorial concessions without a domestic political backlash.

counterpoint.zh: 『凍結Kherson／Zaporizhzhia前線並要求烏克蘭自Donetsk部分區域撤軍』這個具體條款內容，目前僅見於未具名消息來源的報導，美、俄、烏三方官方均未證實，實際27項方案的內容可能與外傳版本有落差，過早把它當成談判基準線本身可能誤導風險評估；Putin的3天停戰令範圍也僅限Kyiv一地，烏克蘭其他城市在此期間是否同樣暫停攻擊尚不明確。
counterpoint.en: The specific terms reportedly involving a Kherson/Zaporizhzhia front-line freeze and a Ukrainian withdrawal from parts of Donetsk currently rest only on unnamed-source reporting; none of the US, Russian or Ukrainian sides have officially confirmed them, and the actual 27-point proposal may differ from the leaked version — treating it as a negotiating baseline this early risks miscalibrating the risk assessment. Putin's three-day pause order is also scoped to Kyiv specifically; whether strikes on other Ukrainian cities are paused during the same window is unclear.

items.source: CNN / CNBC / Euromaidan Press / The Hill

title.zh: 在野兩黨把賴清德將否簽的自家法案，變成卡住NT$6,076億追加預算的門檻：KMT／TPP要求先公告在野版無人機條例，才准立法院討論國防與台電紓困
title.en: Taiwan's Opposition Turns Its Own Unsigned Drone Act Into the Gate for a NT$607.6bn Supplementary Budget: KMT and TPP Say the Cabinet Must Promulgate Their Version First, Before the Legislature Even Discusses Defense and the CPC Bailout

summary.zh: 延續本站9/4報告記錄的追加預算案(9/3行政院核定NT$1,457億國防相關經費，含559億元無人載具支出)：最新進展是，KMT與TPP兩黨團9/4聯合公開表態，對行政院9/3提出、總額達NT$6,076億(約191.3億美元)的追加預算案表達強烈保留，除了抨擊其中編列給台灣中油(CPC Corp)的紓困款項『違法』之外，兩黨團更提出一項前提：行政院與總統賴清德必須先完成公布施行8/26-27立法院已表決通過的在野版《強化國防自主及無人載具產業發展特別條例》，立法院才會討論這筆追加預算案。換言之，在野黨把自己已經表決通過、但行政部門尚未公告施行的法案，變成了讓另一筆(且金額更大、涵蓋範圍更廣)追加預算案能否進入審查的政治門檻。TPP黨團幹事長陳智菡並表示，行政院這次改用追加預算籌措無人機經費的做法，本身就『證明政府先前堅持特別預算的必要性是說謊』。
summary.en: Following our 9/4 report (the Executive Yuan's 9/3 approval of a NT$145.7 billion defense-related supplementary appropriation, including NT$55.9 billion for uncrewed systems): the latest development is that the KMT and TPP caucuses jointly went public on 9/4 with strong reservations about the Cabinet's 9/3 supplementary budget request, totaling NT$607.6 billion (about US$19.13 billion). Beyond calling the bailout funding for CPC Corp, Taiwan included in the package 'illegal,' the two caucuses attached a precondition: the Executive Yuan and President William Lai must first promulgate the opposition's own Act on Strengthening Defense Autonomy and Developing the Unmanned Vehicles Industry — the bill the legislature passed on 8/26-27 — before the legislature will even take up this supplementary budget. In other words, the opposition has turned a bill it already passed but the executive branch has not yet promulgated into the political gate controlling whether a separate, larger, broader-scope supplementary budget can be reviewed at all. TPP caucus whip Chen Chih-han said the Cabinet's resort to a supplementary budget to fund drones this time itself 'proves the government lied' about needing a special budget in the first place.

implication.zh: 這是9/4報告已經標記的『資金可預測性』問題，第一次被證實不是抽象疑慮，而是具體的政治槓桿操作：在野黨並非單純反對這筆追加預算的內容，而是把兩個原本互相獨立的法案綁在一起，讓自己已表決通過的法案(行政院尚未公告施行)成為卡住另一筆錢的人質。對你評估台灣無人機供應鏈訂單能見度，這代表接下來該追蹤的不是NT$1,457億本身夠不夠、或立法院會不會刪減，而是行政院會不會在政治壓力下加速公告施行在野版條例——如果行政院選擇儘速公告換取追加預算過關，等於讓在野黨這次的『綁法案』策略得到正向回饋，未來任何一筆追加預算案都可能被要求綁進其他未了結的政治議程；如果行政院拒絕公告、直接讓追加預算卡關，則國防相關支出的實際到位時間會比帳面數字晚上數月，兩種結果對相關供應商的現金流意義完全不同。
implication.en: This is the first concrete evidence that the 'funding predictability' problem flagged in our 9/4 report isn't an abstract worry but an actual piece of political leverage: the opposition isn't simply objecting to the content of this supplementary budget — it's tying two originally separate bills together, turning a bill it already passed (but the executive hasn't yet promulgated) into a hostage for a different pot of money. For assessing order visibility in Taiwan's drone supply chain, the thing to track now isn't whether the NT$145.7 billion is adequate or whether the legislature will trim it — it's whether the Executive Yuan accelerates promulgation of the opposition's act under this pressure. If the Cabinet promulgates quickly to unlock the supplementary budget, it rewards the opposition's bill-linking tactic, and any future supplementary budget could get held hostage to some other unresolved item on the opposition's agenda. If the Cabinet refuses and lets the supplementary budget stall instead, actual disbursement of defense-related spending will land months later than the headline figure implies — and those two outcomes mean very different things for supplier cash flow.

counterpoint.zh: 在野黨團的表態目前仍是政治喊話階段，尚未正式提出將兩案掛鉤審查的程序性動議，行政院是否真的需要、或依法必須先公告在野版條例才能讓追加預算付委，仍待立法院議事規則層面的實際運作確認；且KMT與TPP在『台電紓困違法』與『綁法案』兩個訴求上，動機與優先順序可能並不完全一致，未必會形成穩定一致的杯葛立場。
counterpoint.en: The opposition caucuses' statement is so far political messaging, not a formally filed procedural motion linking the two bills' review; whether the Cabinet actually needs, or is legally required, to promulgate the opposition's act before the supplementary budget can be referred to committee remains to be confirmed through the legislature's actual procedural mechanics. The KMT's and TPP's motives and priorities on the 'illegal CPC bailout' complaint versus the 'link the bills' demand may not fully align, and the two parties may not maintain a stable, unified blocking position.

title.zh: 俄軍無人機直擊基輔SBU總部大樓，Zelensky稱瞄準的正是代理局長辦公室：戰爭4年半來SBU總部首次挨炸，就發生在美方和談特使啟程前一天
title.en: A Russian Drone Hits SBU Headquarters in Kyiv, Aimed—Zelensky Says—Straight at the Acting Chief's Office: First Time the SBU's Own HQ Has Been Struck in Four and a Half Years of War, One Day Before US Peace Envoys Set Off

summary.zh: 9/4白天，一架俄軍渦輪噴射動力無人機直擊烏克蘭國安局(SBU)位於基輔Volodymyrska街、聖索菲亞大教堂對面的總部大樓，造成至少9人受傷(其中7人送醫)，建築部分樓板結構與外牆受損。Zelensky公開表示，這架無人機瞄準的正是SBU代理局長Oleksandr Poklad本人的辦公室；SBU隨後證實Poklad人身安全、未受傷。這是這場戰爭四年半以來，SBU總部大樓首次直接遭擊中；Zelensky指示Poklad『在準備就緒後，對俄方做出對等且看得見的回應』，並形容這是一起『不折不扣的暗殺企圖』。這起攻擊是Russia對Kyiv連續第9天以噴射動力無人機發動空襲的一部分，也恰好發生在美國總統特使Witkoff與Kushner啟程前往Moscow與Kyiv、展開本屆政府任內首次實地穿梭外交的前一天。這起攻擊距離本站9/4報告記錄的SBU與HUR兩大情報機構9/2在基輔街頭實彈互射事件，僅隔兩天。
summary.en: On the afternoon of 9/4, a Russian turbojet-powered drone struck the Ukrainian Security Service (SBU) headquarters building on Volodymyrska Street in Kyiv, opposite St Sophia Cathedral, injuring at least nine people (seven hospitalized) and damaging part of the building's floor structure and an exterior wall. Zelensky said publicly the drone was aimed directly at the office of acting SBU chief Oleksandr Poklad; the SBU subsequently confirmed Poklad was safe and uninjured. This marks the first time in four and a half years of war that SBU headquarters itself has been directly hit. Zelensky instructed Poklad to deliver 'an appropriate, visible response' to Russia once ready, and called the strike 'nothing short of an assassination attempt.' The attack came on the ninth consecutive day of Russian turbojet-drone strikes on Kyiv, and one day before US presidential envoys Witkoff and Kushner set off for Moscow and Kyiv on the administration's first in-person shuttle-diplomacy push of the war. It also came just two days after the armed SBU-HUR street clash in Kyiv our 9/4 report documented.

implication.zh: 把這起攻擊跟9/4報告已經記錄的SBU-HUR街頭互射放在一起看，這個月的SBU正同時承受外部與內部兩種壓力：對外，總部大樓本身第一次被證明在俄方精準打擊的能力範圍內，且瞄準的是機構首長本人；對內，才兩天前才爆發跟HUR的實彈衝突，凸顯指揮權威本身尚未穩固。對你評估Ukraine戰時治理韌性，這代表SBU作為烏克蘭反滲透與反情報核心節點的可信度，正同時被『能不能保護自己的指揮鏈』與『內部機構互信是否存在』兩條軸線同時考驗——任何只看外部滲透技術指標、不看機構內部摩擦與實體防護缺口的評估，這個月都會系統性低估風險。時間點也值得記住：攻擊發生在美方特使啟程前一天，不論是巧合還是刻意示威，都代表Kyiv是在自身安全機構同時承壓的狀態下，進入這輪和談。
implication.en: Read together with the SBU-HUR street clash our 9/4 report already documented, the SBU is absorbing external and internal pressure simultaneously this month: externally, its own headquarters building has now been proven within range of a precision Russian strike, aimed at the institution's own chief; internally, it was in an armed clash with HUR just two days earlier, underscoring that its command authority isn't fully settled either. For assessing the resilience of Ukraine's wartime governance, the SBU's credibility as the core node for counter-infiltration and counterintelligence is being tested on two axes at once — can it protect its own chain of command, and does inter-agency trust even exist — and any assessment that only tracks external-infiltration technical indicators while ignoring internal friction and physical-protection gaps will systematically underrate the risk this month. The timing is also worth keeping: the strike landed one day before the US envoys' departure. Whether coincidence or deliberate signaling, it means Kyiv is entering this round of talks with its own security apparatus under stress on two fronts at once.

counterpoint.zh: 『瞄準代理局長辦公室』的定性目前僅來自Zelensky本人公開談話，尚無獨立的彈道或目標分析佐證這架無人機當初鎖定的具體座標；渦輪噴射動力無人機本身精準度有限，命中SBU大樓也可能只是這輪對基輔全城範圍轟炸中的隨機結果，而非刻意鎖定特定辦公室。
counterpoint.en: The claim that the drone targeted the acting chief's office specifically rests so far only on Zelensky's own public remarks; there is no independent ballistic or targeting analysis yet confirming the drone's original aimpoint. Turbojet drones have limited precision, and the SBU building may simply have been struck as part of this wave's citywide bombardment of Kyiv rather than a deliberately chosen target.

items.source: Kyiv Independent / CNN / The New Voice of Ukraine / Kyiv Post

title.zh: 五角大廈私下告訴承包商：Anthropic『供應鏈風險』標籤沒有真的撤——9/2報告的警告『這只是程序性勝訴』，4天內就被證實
title.en: The Pentagon Quietly Tells Contractors Anthropic's 'Supply Chain Risk' Label Never Really Came Off — the 9/2 Report's Warning That This Was Only a Procedural Win Held Up Within Four Days

summary.zh: 延續本站9/2報告記錄的訴訟進展(加州聯邦法官8/27裁定該標籤違憲、空軍隨即在9/1原訂撤除期限前改口，通知承包商『不需要』移除Anthropic產品)：最新進展是，一名五角大廈資深官員9/3向媒體證實，儘管加州地院裁決在案，國防部對Anthropic的『供應鏈風險』標籤『依然有效』——與空軍9/1一度對承包商釋出的鬆動訊號並不一致。這與9/2報告當時已經預告的結構完全吻合：DC巡迴上訴法院5月19日開庭時，三位法官(Katsas、Rao、Henderson)當庭立場明顯分歧，國防部律師主張Anthropic『有能力干擾五角大廈在關鍵軍事行動上使用其AI模型』，Anthropic律師則主張標籤本身『違反國會授權程序、逾越法定權限、且違憲』；DC巡迴案本身尚未宣判，國防部部門級9/29撤除期限也仍未正式撤銷。與此同時，國防部本身已在9月初開放War Department員工使用Grok與ChatGPT(與稍早已開放的Google Gemini並列)作為官方認可的AI工具選項，形成『拒用Anthropic、開放其他供應商』的對比態勢。
summary.en: Following our 9/2 report (California federal judge's 8/27 ruling that the label was unconstitutional, and the Air Force's reversal just ahead of its own 9/1 removal deadline, telling contractors they were 'not required' to remove Anthropic products): the latest development is that a senior Pentagon official confirmed to media on 9/3 that, notwithstanding the California district court ruling, the Defense Department's 'supply chain risk' designation on Anthropic 'remains in effect' — at odds with the loosening signal the Air Force had briefly sent contractors on 9/1. This matches exactly the structure our 9/2 report already flagged: at the D.C. Circuit's 19 May oral argument, the three-judge panel (Katsas, Rao, Henderson) showed a clear split, with a DOJ attorney arguing Anthropic 'has the ability to interfere with the Pentagon's use of its AI model for critical military operations' and Anthropic's counsel arguing the designation 'defied congressionally mandated procedures, exceeded statutory limits and violated the Constitution.' The D.C. Circuit itself has not yet ruled, and the department-wide 9/29 removal deadline has still not been formally rescinded. At the same time, the Department of War opened up Grok and ChatGPT to its workforce in early September as officially sanctioned AI tools (alongside the previously approved Google Gemini) — pairing a continued freeze-out of Anthropic with an open door for other vendors.

implication.zh: 這條線索直接驗證了9/2報告當時的警告：那次裁決解決的只是程序問題，完全沒有觸及實質爭議(AI供應商能不能對自主致命目標選定與國內監控設下不可退讓的紅線)，國防部只要靠著DC巡迴案這條平行法律路徑，就能在加州地院判它敗訴後，繼續對外維持原有立場——這正是9/2報告指出的『行政部門只需換一條法律依據，同樣的施壓路徑仍然可以重來一次』，如今4天內就被證實成真，而不是需要數月才驗證的長期預測。對你判斷其他AI供應商未來若想比照Anthropic設下類似軍事用途紅線，這代表『打贏一場地院訴訟』不能被當成風向指標——真正決定這條線能不能站得住的，是DC巡迴案的最終裁決與9/29那個從未被正式撤銷的部門級期限，這兩個變數目前都還沒有解，而國防部同步開放Grok、ChatGPT供內部使用，等於用行動告訴市場『我們有的是替代選項』，讓Anthropic在這場拉鋸戰裡的談判籌碼並不會隨時間自然增加。
implication.en: This directly verifies the warning our 9/2 report already made: that ruling resolved only a procedural question and never touched the substantive dispute — whether an AI vendor can hold a non-negotiable red line against autonomous lethal targeting and domestic surveillance. All the Pentagon needed was the parallel D.C. Circuit track to keep asserting its position publicly even after losing in the California district court. That is exactly the mechanism our 9/2 report called out — 'switching to a different legal basis lets the same pressure campaign run again' — and it held up within four days rather than needing months to test. For judging whether any other AI vendor could draw a similar military-use red line in the future, this means winning one district-court case cannot be read as a weathervane: what actually decides whether the line holds is the D.C. Circuit's eventual ruling and the never-formally-rescinded 9/29 department-wide deadline, both still open. The Pentagon simultaneously opening Grok and ChatGPT to its own workforce for official use signals to the market, through action rather than words, that it has alternatives — meaning Anthropic's negotiating leverage in this standoff doesn't automatically grow just because time passes.

counterpoint.zh: 9/3向媒體證實標籤『依然有效』的是一名匿名的『資深國防部官員』，並非國防部正式發布的聲明或文件，其表態可能只反映內部特定部門(如國防部長辦公室)的立場，未必代表整個部門(尤其是已對外鬆口的空軍)的最終執行狀態會維持一致；若DC巡迴案最終判決對Anthropic有利，這個『依然有效』的表態屆時可能迅速反轉。
counterpoint.en: The 9/3 confirmation that the label 'remains in effect' came from an anonymous 'senior Defense Department official,' not a formal Pentagon statement or document — it may reflect the position of one specific office (such as the Secretary's) rather than a settled, department-wide execution status, particularly given the Air Force had already signaled otherwise. If the D.C. Circuit ultimately rules for Anthropic, this 'still in effect' framing could reverse quickly.

items.source: Washington Examiner（引述五角大廈資深官員）
